Elaine (PM): Quick sync — operator minimal upgrade lanes + telemetry for private deployments. Goal: define minimal onramp (no net changes for customer) and the telemetry hooks we need for rollback detection. Need decisions by EOD Fri.
Amar (Eng): TL;DR constraints: installers can't change egress IP, must support offline airgap, and upgrades must be restartless where possible. Telemetry must be opt-in and light.
Tess (Field): Top customer asks: 1) zero-downtime for tenant traffic, 2) preserve egress IPs, 3) a simple toggle for enable/disable telemetry for security teams. Also they'd like upgrade window guidance.
Leo (SRE): On restartless upgrades — we can do in-place sidecar swap for runtime components. We need health probes and KV cache warmup metrics. Suggest metrics: upgrade.progress, cache.fill_rate, steady_latency_95.
Amar (Eng): Proposed minimal payload: operator v0.9 shim, k8s job for migrations, and a control plane connector that can be toggled. Example install: `kubectl apply -f https://redwood-cdn/priv-operator/v0.9/minimal.yaml`
Tess (Field): Can we avoid changing BGP or NAT configs? Customers will refuse any new egress ranges.
Amar (Eng): Yes — keep existing NAT/BGP unchanged. All networking changes optional and behind feature flags.
Samir (Support): Need runbook steps for rollback and detection alarms. If upgrade.progress stalls > 10m or steady_latency_95 increases > 200ms, auto-rollback. Who owns the rollback playbook?
Elaine (PM): Action: Amar to draft upgrade flow + flag matrix; Leo to propose telemetry thresholds; Samir to draft rollback runbook. Tess to validate with top 3 customers. Check-in Tue 10am.
DevOpsBot: deploy-notify: staging/operator-v0.9 deployed to staging cluster redwood-priv-stg at 1759316000 :rocket: 
Amar (Eng): Quick config snippet for opt-in telemetry toggle:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: priv-operator-config
data:
  telemetry.enabled: "false"
```
Leo (SRE): Also add a `telemetry.redaction` list to strip IPs before sending. Security wants that.
Tess (Field): Customers will need a short comms template — Samir can we prep one that says 'no egress change, minimal downtime, opt-in telemetry'? :+1: 
Samir (Support): On it. I'll write a one-pager and a slotted 30min tech call template.
Elaine (PM): Nice. I'll open a tracking GH issue with the action items and link to this thread. Final ask: keep upgrade image tags immutable for at least 30 days post-rollout.
Amar (Eng): Acknowledged. I'll include image immutability and canary percentages (10% then 50% then 100%).
Elaine (PM): Thanks — see you Tue 10am. Filing notes.
